{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|A Tech Raiders base. The black marketeers from long ago. Thaal and his original Pop-Dogs hid out in one of their bases near the city of Vangard to do their guerrilla activities against the Yuuzhan Vong.|Bhindi Drayson|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tech Raiders''' were an organization of criminals that stole tech equipment and later sold them on the black market to people such as [[Didi Oddo]].<ref name="TDH">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Deadly Hunter]]''</ref> In [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]], they relocated their base to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" /> Their representative and broker on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was [[Helb]].<ref name="TDH" />
